run_ensemble_experiment: run a BenchMARL experiment with ensemble algorithms and models for agent and adversary roles
create_ensemble_algorithm_config: create an EnsembleAlgorithmConfig with MappoConfig for the agent and IppoConfig for the adversary
create_ensemble_model_config: create an EnsembleModelConfig with MlpConfig for the agent and GnnConfig for the adversary
load_experiment_config_from_yaml: load an ExperimentConfig from the base_experiment.yaml configuration file
load_vmas_task_from_yaml: load a VmasTask SIMPLE_TAG environment from the simple_tag.yaml configuration file
